value0.comment: Empirically-fit LED-reference-frame -> mocap accelerometer-IMU-frame bridge (T_ledRef_mocapAccelImu), fit against real vision + mocap. Refit 2026-09-22 after adding the vision-clock DRIFT correction (mocap_vision_drift_offset_ns=-2.50ms, mocap_vision_drift_rate_ms_per_min=+2.50, on top of the existing mocap_vision_offset_ns=7.60ms) to the mocap lookup, on STRONG poses only (n_inliers/error_px thresholds from fusion_heuristic), pooled over all 8 recordings-aug26 (static_dark/static_medium/static_hard from fresh full runs), 1/err^2-weighted chordal mean with iterative 3-MAD outlier trimming. Numerically almost identical to the pre-drift-correction bridge (backed up under data/mocap_calib/backup_pre_drift_correction/) -- the drift term's benefit is in asymmetric/partial time coverage (a held-out time-block test, or any frame_range subset/live run), not in this full, symmetric-coverage aggregate fit, where a plain constant already centers itself. Not derived from factory Rt. Trimmed pooled residual: rot 0.959+/-0.493 deg, trans 5.106+/-2.277 mm (median 0.92 deg / 4.93 mm over all 13133 strong frames).
